root_cause.statement: The 31AC candidate places __TEXT_EXEC.fileoff (131072) after __TEXT_BOOT_EXEC.fileoff (65536); the installer's split-protection file-offset check subtracts these as unsigned and underflows, which is a plausible cause of the reported fileset error / exit 71.
root_cause.qualification: The actual Recovery error text and gating analyzer profile were never observed (actual_recovery_profile UNOBSERVED). The offline analyzer derived the gating profile as false on the path it could follow. No component-level cause is confirmed; the cause of exit 71 remains Unknown.
